title: The application must record a time stamp indicating when the event occurred.
check_content:
Review the application logs.

If the time the event occurred is not included as part of the event, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the application to record the time the event occurred when recording the event.
VulnDiscussion: It is important to include the time stamps for when an event occurred. Failure to include time stamps in the event logs is detrimental to forensic analysis.
